source_policy.fail_closed_rule: If a current FSSAI/FoSCoS provision cannot be verified from an official source, PMSV keeps the rule locked/incomplete and does not substitute a third-party or older-source value.

category_entries.condition: On served-to-consumer basis.

category_entries.condition: For use as a flavour carrier only.

category_entries.condition: On served-to-consumer basis.

category_entries.condition: On served-to-consumer basis.

Quillaia extracts
category_entries.condition: On saponin basis. Note 132 gives a separate semi-frozen beverage exception.

category_entries.condition: As tin.

category_entries.condition: As added level; residue not detected in ready-to-eat food. Final-product methanol maximum stated as 200 mg/L.

category_entries.name: Saffron
category_entries.condition: Good Manufacturing Practice.

category_entries.condition: Note 219 gives 5,000 mg/kg only for specified aniseed-, coconut- and almond-based drinks.

category_entries.name: Sunset Yellow FCF
category_entries.condition: On served-to-consumer basis.

category_entries.name: Thiodipropionates
category_entries.condition: On fat/oil basis; as thiodipropionic acid.

category_entries.condition: Chapter 2.10 carbonated-water standard also gives 100 ppm expressed as quinine sulphate.

category_entries.name: Canthaxanthin
category_entries.condition: Specific 14.1.4.1 limit; replaces the broader parent-category value of 100 mg/kg for this subcategory.

category_entries.name: Lauric arginate ethyl ester
category_entries.condition: Specific to carbonated water-based flavoured drinks.

category_entries.name: Riboflavins
category_entries.condition: Specific 14.1.4.1 additive limit; parent 14.1.4 lists 100 mg/kg. Product standard separately permits riboflavin as a vitamin up to 100% RDA.

category_entries.name: Saccharins
category_entries.condition: Specific 14.1.4.1 Appendix A limit. Chapter 2.10 carbonated-water standard is stricter for saccharin sodium at 100 ppm.
